headline: 建築新提案：美中兩藝術館
context: 建築界本週有兩則新消息：美國麻州克拉克藝術中心（Clark Art Institute）公布擴建設計，由Selldorf建築事務所操刀；中國廣州附近則有建築團隊Vector Architects公布亞朗雅藝術中心，捨棄常見的白盒子展廳，圍繞一棵老榕樹打造。

sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: The Clark Art Institute, a prominent art institution located in the Berkshires of western Massachusetts , United States , has unveiled images of the design for the extension of its current facilities. The institution, opened in 1955, is both an art museum and a center for research, critical discussion, and higher education in the visual arts. The new wing, commissioned to Selldorf Architects in October 2024, will expand the current gallery and art storage space and connect the Museum Building and the Manton Research Center, previously renovated by the same firm. The new building will be complemented by a landscape design by Reed Hilderbrand , reinforcing the experience of the architecture, art, and surrounding Berkshire landscape.
sources.title: Selldorf Architects Unveils Design for Clark Art Institute Extension in Massachusetts

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Architecture studio Vector Architects has arranged a cluster of art galleries around a preserved Banyan tree canopy near Guangzhou, China. Developed for Aranya Jiulong Lake, a holiday retreat near Jiulong Lake Reservoir 45 kilometres away from central Guangzhou, the art centre was broken into several free-standing galleries connected by gardens and plazas. sources.title: Vector Architects rejects "white cube" design for Aranya Art Center Guangzhou

📌 八大藝術

建築新提案：美中兩藝術館

建築這邊有兩則新消息。美國麻州伯克夏地區的克拉克藝術中心（Clark Art Institute，1955年開館），公布了擴建設計，由Selldorf建築事務所操刀，2024年10月接下委託。新的展館會串連現有的美術館主樓與曼頓研究中心（Manton Research Center，先前也是同一間事務所翻新的），景觀設計則交給Reed Hilderbrand事務所。

另一頭，中國廣州附近，建築團隊Vector Architects公布了亞朗雅藝術中心的設計。這座藝術中心距離廣州市中心約45公里，靠近九龍湖水庫，捨棄常見的「白盒子」展廳做法，改把好幾座獨立展館圍繞一棵保留下來的老榕樹樹冠展開，中間用花園和廣場串接。

—— 本則整理自 ArchDaily 與 Dezeen，2026 年 7 月 20 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 建築這邊有兩件新事。美國麻州的克拉克藝術中心公布了擴建設計，由Selldorf建築事務所操刀，會把現有的美術館主樓和研究中心串連起來，戶外景觀交給另一家事務所設計。另一頭，中國廣州附近，有建築團隊公布了亞朗雅藝術中心的設計。這次他們沒有用常見的「白盒子」展廳做法，而是把好幾座獨立展館，圍繞一棵保留下來的老榕樹展開，中間用花園和廣場串接起來。
